description: This file defines a report for prospects engaged but not converted in the CRM module of an ERP system, including functions to generate report columns, fetch data, and apply filters based on lead activity and age.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: set_defaut_value_for_filters
methods.description: Sets default values for 'no_of_interaction' and 'lead_age' filters if not provided.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the structure and labels of the report columns.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches lead data and communication history based on filters.

methods.name: get_lead_filters
methods.description: Constructs filters for lead query based on lead status and age.

methods.name: get_creation_date_based_on_lead_age
methods.description: Calculates the date threshold for lead age filtering.
